refresh_state.name: Refresh state
refresh_state.description: Get the newest status for all devices and entities from controller.

config_backup.name: Make controller configuration backup
config_backup.description: Create Exta Life controller configuration backup.

entity_id.name: Entity
entity_id.description: Entity ID representing controller for which configuration backup should be created.

schedule.name: Schedule
schedule.description: Allows to create separate backup schedules for specified periods (daily, weekly, monthly, etc.). The created config backup will contain the indicated schedule name as a part of its name.

retention.name: Retention
retention.description: Specifies how many recent backups are to be kept; if the value '0' is indicated, backup rotation will not be performed.

path.name: Path
path.description: Path to the directory where the backup file will be saved. If the path is left empty, then the file will be saved in the HA configuration directory in the extalife directory. If you provide a relative path, it will be appended to the HA configuration path. With an absolute path, the copy file will be saved exactly in the specified location. If the target path does not exist, it will be created.

test_button.name: Test transmitter button
test_button.description: Simulate Exta Life transmitter event like a button up, down, click etc.

event.name: Event
event.description: Event to simulate: single, double, triple, down, up

record_traffic.name: Record controller traffic
record_traffic.description: Record all messages exchanged with the controller to a file in config/extalife/recordings. Login and password are removed. Useful for reporting problems and adding support for new devices.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Recording time in minutes. 0 stops the recording in progress and saves it.

recording_in_progress.message: Traffic recording is already in progress

notification_recording_saved_message.message:
{messages} messages ({size} bytes) have been saved to `{path}`.

Login and password are removed, but the file contains device names, serial numbers and network addresses of the controller. Attach it to an issue only if you are fine with that.

command_failed.message: The controller did not confirm the command for {entity}. The device may be out of range or not responding.

controller_offline.title: Exta Life controller "{title}" is offline
controller_offline.description: Home Assistant has not been able to connect to the EFC-01 controller "{title}" ({host}) for more than {minutes} minutes. Check that the controller is powered and reachable in your network. The integration keeps trying to reconnect and this issue disappears once the connection is restored.

unsupported_devices.title: Unsupported Exta Life devices
unsupported_devices.description: The controller "{title}" reports devices which are not supported by the integration yet: {devices}. They are ignored. If you want them to be supported, please open an issue at {issue_tracker} and attach the diagnostics file of the integration (credentials are removed from it).
